dial.summary: Macro backdrop remains mixed but not deteriorating: Global M2 still expanding at $103.7T (G4 Aug 2026), BTC funding at 0.0100% per 8h (well below 0.04% overheating threshold), and the Fed balance sheet flat-to-expanding at $6.76T; real yields hold at 2.78% and DXY ticked to 101.83 — both sustaining headwinds — but BTC.D at 59.4% shows no imminent alt rotation; FOMC Oct 28 rate decision (25bp hike to 4.00%–4.25% widely expected post back-to-back CPI/PPI shocks) is the dominant near-term catalyst.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$103.7T for August 2026 (latest month with all four economies reporting; 4-week trend UP: July $102.64T → August $103.66T, +$1.02T, +1.0% MoM); US M2 at $23.34T for August (FRED H.6, up 5.7% YoY, 28th consecutive monthly increase); September G4 aggregate still unavailable (6–8 week reporting lag); status supportive (4-week trend is up); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); October PMI release scheduled November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET (confirmed by ISM release calendar); status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~101.83 (Oct 19, 2026 per Trading Economics; Oct 16 close 101.84; daily change -0.01%); 4-week trend UP from ~100.29 on Sep 18 (~+1.5%); 52-week range 95.55–102.95; status headwind (above 100 threshold); FOMC Oct 28 25bp hike to 4.00%–4.25% would likely extend DXY toward 103+.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.78% as of October 15, 2026 (Fed H.15 release Oct 16; confirmed via Treasury daily real yield curve; Oct 14 = 2.84%, Oct 13 = 2.88%); 4-week trend UP from ~2.52% on Sep 15 to 2.78% (+26bps); Oct 16–19 FRED readings not yet confirmed in public sources; status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and above 2% threshold).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 16, 2026: US 10yr ~5.09%, 2yr ~4.74% → 2s10s spread ~+35bps (FRED T10Y2Y: 0.35 on Oct 16, 0.33 on Oct 15, 0.37 on Oct 14); Oct 19: 10yr at 5.07% (Trading Economics), 2yr not yet confirmed; 4-week trend DOWN (Sep 15 ~+42bps → Oct 16 +35bps = −7bps flattening); status neutral — curve positively sloped but flattening; FOMC Oct 28 hike would compress spread further.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at ~$6.76T for week ending October 14, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 15, 2026; confirmed by Trading Tools citing FRED WALCL; prior week Oct 7 = ~$6.75T, +$8B WoW); 4-week trend flat: Sep 16 ~$6.747T → Oct 14 ~$6.756T = +$9B (+0.13%); status supportive (flat near post-QT-pause stabilization plateau — Reserve Management Purchases offsetting MBS runoff); next H.4.1 release October 22, 2026 (covers week ending Oct 21).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0100% as of October 18, 2026 (Tokenpost snapshot; longs paying shorts, open interest ~$7.76B, long accounts at 62.5%); Oct 17 dipped to 0.0035% (Saturday); 30-day trend UP from ~0.0067% on Sep 30 to 0.0100% on Oct 18; rate well below the 0.04% per 8h overheating threshold; status supportive (spot-driven accumulation confirmed, no speculative leverage excess).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$302.3B (DefiLlama Oct 18, 2026; USDT $183.4B, USDC $72.6B) vs total crypto ~$2.71T; dominance ~11.2%; BTC.D at 59.4% (TV-Hub Oct 18); 30-day trend UP (Sep 17 est. ~10.5% → Oct 19 ~11.2%); status neutral — stablecoin dominance rising but total crypto market cap is flat-to-lower (was ~$2.84T late Sep, now ~$2.71T), so the headwind condition (rising dom + rising TOTAL simultaneously) is not triggered.

upcoming.title: Housing Starts & Building Permits (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases September 2026 Housing Starts and Building Permits at 8:30 AM ET; with real yields at 2.78% and mortgage rates elevated, continued monthly declines would underscore the drag from high financing costs on residential investment; provides incremental Q3 data ahead of the October 29 GDP advance estimate.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 18, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 18, 2026 — one of the last major labor data points before the October 28 FOMC decision; a sustained trend above 220K would raise recession risk; carries outsized weight given the September NFP of +29K, hot CPI (3.7% YoY), and hot PPI (6.3% YoY) backdrop heading into the meeting.

upcoming.title: Fed Balance Sheet H.4.1 (week ending October 21, 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases weekly H.4.1 balance sheet data (week ending Oct 21) at 4:30 PM ET; prior reading was $6.76T (Oct 14); any acceleration in asset runoff ahead of the Oct 28 FOMC meeting would be notable.

upcoming.title: S&P Global US Flash PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases preliminary October 2026 Manufacturing and Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET — first Q4 activity data point, released four days before the FOMC meeting begins; September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% sets a high bar; a flash manufacturing print below 52 would suggest deceleration and reinforce Fed hold expectations despite hot inflation.
